metadata.Name: 20min-XD
metadata.Description: A French-German, document-level comparable corpus of around 15,000 news article pairs from the Swiss online news outlet 20 Minuten / 20 minutes, spanning 2015 to 2024. The articles were automatically aligned based on semantic similarity.
metadata.Paper Title: 20min-XD: A Comparable Corpus of Swiss News Articles
Affiliations: Department of Computational Linguistics, University of Zurich
metadata.Abstract: We present 20min-XD ( 20 Min uten cross -lingual d ocument-level), a French-German, document-level comparable corpus of news articles, sourced from the Swiss online news outlet 20 Minuten / 20 minutes . Our dataset comprises around 15,000 article pairs spanning 2015 to 2024, automatically aligned based on semantic similarity. We detail the data collection process and alignment methodology. Furthermore, we provide a qualitative and quantitative analysis of the corpus. The resulting dataset exhibits a broad spectrum of cross-lingual similarity, ranging from near-translations to loosely related articles, making it valuable for various NLP applications and broad linguistically motivated studies. We publicly release the dataset in document- and sentence-aligned versions and code for the described experiments 1 , 2 .
